label: Early copy-phase outputs (2nd-4th recalled token) in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase. Never fires in the original phase, on the <DEL> step, or when outputting original token 0. Activity is concentrated on outputs 1-3 (recall_idx 1-3), and recall_idx 2 (the step two after <DEL>) holds about 53% of the activation mass. It is strongly length-dependent: it never fires for L<=5, rarely for L=6-7, and L=9 holds 71% of the mass. The top activations are at recall_idx 1 in L=9 sequences. There is a small secondary bump at the last two outputs of L=9 sequences (recall_idx 7-8, about 2% of mass). Within the predicted region it fires on only about half of the steps. The input/output token identity modulates whether it fires (s, r, x and digit-rich sequences fire more often), but no simple token rule improved F1. Predicate on dev: P 0.53, R 0.82, mass recall 0.90.
